segments.text: Consider that however the Word hath no power upon you, the commandment cannot come home to your hearts; yet it doth work, and comes home with power to the hearts of others: whilest you are hardened, others are melted under it: whilest you sleep, others tremble; whilest your hearts are fast locked up, others are opened: how can you choose but reflect with fear and trembling upon these contrary effects of the word? especially when you consider that the eternal decrees both of election and reprobation are now executed upon the souls of men by the preaching of the Word. Some believe, and others are hardened.
